calculate_huber_loss: calculate huber loss on an input tensor with a specified quadratic-linear boundary
clip_gradients_huber: clip gradients using huber loss for DQN and its variants
validate_boundary_positive: validate that the quadratic-linear boundary parameter is greater than zero
compute_quadratic_linear_loss: compute quadratic loss for small values and linear loss for large absolute values
avoid_gradient_doubling: avoid gradient doubling at the boundary by using smooth huber loss formulation
